prTitle: Add Groups resource type and scopes to authorization schema
head: 7355f05e6aafe2a7acc6434fb40c686665416606

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found with gh search prs by title. The PR has a single commit equal to the benchmark head (7355f05e6a); it was merged into main as 679f44692d with the same commit message, so the merged code matches the benchmark head.

tps.bug: Removing the canViewGlobal short-circuit from the subgroup and group listings makes an admin with an all-groups V2 grant run one full authorization evaluation per group in the listing instead of a single check.
tps.evidenciaOpus: GroupResource.getSubGroups now filters with auth.groups()::canView on every subgroup (GroupResource.java:177-179) after the cached canViewGlobal short-circuit was removed. In GroupPermissionsV2.canView(GroupModel), an admin without a VIEW_USERS/MANAGE_USERS role runs hasPermission per group: findByName, findByResource and a full policy evaluation. The filter also runs before pagination over all subgroups (getSubGroupsStream(-1,-1)).
tps.evidenciaAstra: GroupResource.java:176-180 removes the cached global-view shortcut and calls canView(g) for each subgroup traversed before pagination. GroupPermissionsV2.java:56-61,141-152 evaluates permissions each time, including repeatedly evaluating the same all-groups resource; MgmtPermissions.java:347-351 starts a fresh evaluation without caching the result. This introduces meaningful authorization overhead proportional to the subgroups traversed, especially for large pagination offsets.
